PIZZA HEN R4 uses only OnionHEN 0.0.10's debug-settings route policy as the
source authority for firmware-aware Debug Settings URI selection.

Copied byte-for-byte into:
  Source Code/daemon/include/onion/debug_settings_route_policy.hpp

hardware-PASS R3 v0.1 Debug Services bridge.
